# Attraction is not returning / 吸引即不返回

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`attraction-is-not-returning` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](attraction-is-not-returning.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Every determined law draws exactly what does not return; what can be had n steps on absorbs every lost possibility, and two merged configurations do not both return. Attraction is merging in finitely many configurations, not in an open world; entering an invariant region of a process locks in.
>
> 每个确定的律恰吸入不返回者；n 步后可得者吸收每个丧失的可能，被合并的两个配置不都返回。有限多配置之内吸引即合并，开放的世界中则不然；过程中进入不变区域即锁定。

## Laws / 规律

1. For a determined law next on configurations of any kind, a region is absorbing when it holds next s wherever it holds s; s is drawn into a region when s lies outside it and the course of s enters it at some step; s is drawn when some absorbing region draws it in; what lies ahead of s is its course from next s on.<br>对任意类型配置上的确定的律 next：区域吸收，是指它含 s 处就含 next s；s 被吸入一个区域，是指 s 在其外而 s 的轨道在某一步进入它；s 被吸入，是指有吸收区域把它吸入；s 的前方是从 next s 起轨道上的配置。 (`Becoming.Law.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.Absorbing`, `Becoming.Law.DrawnInto`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn`, `Becoming.Law.Ahead`)
2. What lies ahead is absorbing; once a course is in an absorbing region it is in it at every later step; a configuration returns exactly where it lies ahead of itself.<br>前方吸收；轨道进入吸收区域之后每一步都在其中；配置返回，恰当它在自己的前方。 (`Becoming.Law.absorbing_ahead`, `Becoming.Law.Absorbing.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.returns_iff_ahead`, `Becoming.Law.Returns`)
3. Lock-in: where a region is absorbing, s lies outside it and the course of s is in it at step n, the course is not s at any step from n on; so a drawn configuration never returns.<br>锁定：区域吸收、s 在其外、s 的轨道在第 n 步在其中时，从第 n 步起轨道每一步都不是 s；所以被吸入的配置不返回。 (`Becoming.Law.DrawnInto.never_back`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_returns`)
4. The main law, with no premise, no finiteness and no decidability: a configuration is drawn exactly where it does not return. One that does not return is drawn into what lies ahead of it, entering at the first step.<br>主律，不加前提、不用有限性与可判定性：配置被吸入，恰当它不返回。不返回的配置被吸入自己的前方，在第一步进入。 (`Becoming.Law.drawn_iff_not_returns`, `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_ahead`)
5. The future narrows: what can be had n steps on is absorbing; a configuration that cannot be had n steps on is drawn into it, entering at step n, and so is drawn; what returns is absorbing.<br>未来收窄：n 步后可得者吸收；n 步后不可得的配置被吸入其中，在第 n 步进入，所以被吸入；返回者吸收。 (`Becoming.Law.Reachable`, `Becoming.Law.reachable_absorbing`, `Becoming.Law.reachable_orbit`, `Becoming.Law.lost_drawn`, `Becoming.Law.drawn_of_lost`, `Becoming.Law.returning_absorbing`)
6. Merging: of two different configurations the law takes to one, not both return, with no finiteness, since two periods meet (a + (a + 1)·b = b + (b + 1)·a); so not both escape being drawn, and a law that merges draws something, both in double-negation form. Where nothing is drawn, two configurations taken to one are not apart, and with decidable equality the law merges nothing.<br>合并：律把两个不同配置带到同一个时，两者不都返回，不需要有限性，因为两个周期相遇（a + (a + 1)·b = b + (b + 1)·a）；所以两者不都免于被吸入，合并的律吸入某个配置，两者都是双重否定的形式。没有配置被吸入时，被带到同一个的两个配置不相异；相等可判定时律不合并。 (`Becoming.Law.Merges`, `Becoming.Law.periods_meet`, `Becoming.Law.Merges.not_both_return`, `Becoming.Law.merge_draws`, `Becoming.Law.Merges.draws`, `Becoming.Law.none_drawn_merges_nothing`, `Becoming.Law.none_drawn_lossless`)
7. Where a list holds every configuration, a drawn configuration rules out that the law merges nothing and that it keeps every possibility, and a law that merges nothing draws nothing; with decidable equality as well, the law merges nothing exactly where nothing is drawn.<br>列表持有每个配置时，有配置被吸入就排除律不合并、也排除律保有每个可能，不合并的律不吸入任何配置；相等也可判定时，律不合并恰当没有配置被吸入。 (`Becoming.Law.KeepsPossibilities`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_lossless`, `Becoming.Law.Lossless.not_drawn`, `Becoming.Law.Drawn.not_keeps`, `Becoming.Law.lossless_iff_none_drawn`)
8. There, a configuration returns exactly where it can be had at every step, so it is drawn exactly where it cannot be had at every step (right to left with no list); every course enters a configuration that returns, so a configuration that does not return is drawn into what returns.<br>此时配置返回恰当它在每一步都可得，所以被吸入恰当它不是每一步都可得（从右到左不需要列表）；每条轨道进入一个返回的配置，所以不返回的配置被吸入返回者的区域。 (`Becoming.Law.returns_iff_always_reachable`, `Becoming.Law.drawn_iff_lost`, `Becoming.Law.enters_returning`, `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_returning`)
9. Open witnesses: under counting on, 0 is drawn and nothing merges; under counting down, 1 is drawn while every number can be had at every step.<br>开放的见证：往上数时 0 被吸入而没有合并；往下数时 1 被吸入，而每个数在每一步都可得。 (`Becoming.Law.succ_drawn_lossless`, `Becoming.Law.pred_drawn_keeps`, `Becoming.Law.pred_orbit_zero`)
10. For processes: a region is absorbing under a determined law exactly where it is invariant under the law's process. A region is absorbing under a move when every step by that move from inside it stays inside; it is invariant exactly where it is absorbing under every move; from inside an invariant region, what lies outside it cannot be reached.<br>过程：区域在确定的律下吸收，恰当它在该律的过程下不变。区域在一个动作下吸收，是指从其内以该动作所走的每一步都留在其内；区域不变，恰当它在每个动作下吸收；从不变区域之内，不能到达其外。 (`Becoming.Law.process`, `Becoming.Law.absorbing_iff_invariant`, `Becoming.AbsorbingUnder`, `Becoming.invariant_iff_every_move`, `Becoming.Invariant`, `Becoming.Invariant.locks_out`, `Becoming.Reach`)
11. Along a run: from a step at which it is inside an invariant region, no later configuration is one at which it was outside; where every move from step n on keeps a region the run is in at step n, it stays in it; where it is inside at step n and outside at step n + 1, the move at step n does not keep the region.<br>沿一个运行：从它在不变区域之内的一步起，以后的配置都不是它曾在区域之外的配置；运行在第 n 步在一个区域中、从第 n 步起每个动作都保持该区域时，它留在其中；第 n 步在其内、第 n + 1 步在其外时，第 n 步的动作不保持该区域。 (`Becoming.Run.locked_in`, `Becoming.Run.stays`, `Becoming.Run.leaving_needs`)
12. In Ratchet every configuration goes to true: the law merges false and true, {true} is absorbing, false is drawn into it, never returns and cannot be had one step on, and true returns and is not drawn.<br>Ratchet 中每个配置都到 true：律合并 false 与 true，{true} 吸收，false 被吸入它而不返回，也在一步后不可得，true 返回而不被吸入。 (`Becoming.Ratchet.next`, `Becoming.Ratchet.atTrue`, `Becoming.Ratchet.merges`, `Becoming.Ratchet.absorbing`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_drawn`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_never_returns`, `Becoming.Ratchet.false_lost`, `Becoming.Ratchet.true_returns`, `Becoming.Ratchet.true_not_drawn`)
13. In Exit the move false keeps the configuration and the move true flips it: {true} is absorbing under false and not under true, so it is not invariant; the run that only moves false stays in {true}, and the run that leaves takes, at its first step, a move that does not keep {true}.<br>Exit 中动作 false 保持配置、动作 true 翻转它：{true} 在 false 下吸收、在 true 下不吸收，所以不是不变量；只取 false 的运行留在 {true} 中，离开的运行第一步所取的动作不保持 {true}。 (`Becoming.Exit.move`, `Becoming.Exit.process`, `Becoming.Exit.atTrue`, `Becoming.Exit.keeps`, `Becoming.Exit.leaves`, `Becoming.Exit.not_invariant`, `Becoming.Exit.staying`, `Becoming.Exit.locked_in`, `Becoming.Exit.leaving`, `Becoming.Exit.leaving_takes`)

## Conditions / 条件

- The main law and lock-in: any determined law next : S → S on a type of any kind; no premise about the law or the unfolding, no finiteness and no decidability.<br>主律与锁定：任意类型上的任意确定的律 next : S → S；不加关于律或展开的前提，不用有限性与可判定性。
- Finitely many configurations: a list holds every configuration (every : ∀ x, x ∈ all), written only into the laws that use it (Drawn.not_lossless, Lossless.not_drawn, Drawn.not_keeps, lossless_iff_none_drawn, returns_iff_always_reachable, drawn_iff_lost left to right, enters_returning, drawnInto_returning).<br>有限多配置：某个列表持有每个配置（every : ∀ x, x ∈ all），只写在用到它的规律中（Drawn.not_lossless、Lossless.not_drawn、Drawn.not_keeps、lossless_iff_none_drawn、returns_iff_always_reachable、drawn_iff_lost 从左到右、enters_returning、drawnInto_returning）。
- Decidable equality (DecidableEq S) only in none_drawn_lossless and lossless_iff_none_drawn; which of two merged configurations is drawn is not chosen, and merge_draws and Merges.draws are double-negation forms only.<br>可判定相等（DecidableEq S）只在 none_drawn_lossless 与 lossless_iff_none_drawn；被合并的两个配置中哪一个被吸入不选出，merge_draws 与 Merges.draws 只是双重否定的形式。
- For processes: any process P and region R; Run.stays has as its condition that every move the run takes from step n on keeps the region, written into the theorem.<br>对过程：任意过程 P 与区域 R；Run.stays 的条件是运行从第 n 步起所取的每个动作都保持区域，写在定理中。
- For the witnesses: Ratchet's law and Exit's process and runs.<br>见证的结论：Ratchet 的律与 Exit 的过程与运行。
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0.<br>离散的步（从第 0 步计）。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The main law is close to definitional: being drawn asks only for some absorbing region, and the region used is the configuration's own course ahead.<br>主律近乎定义：被吸入只要求存在一个吸收区域，所用的区域是配置自己的前方。 Witness: `Becoming.Law.drawnInto_ahead`.
- It identifies lock-in with not returning and is not an attractor in the classical sense (attracting a neighbourhood, minimal, with a topology or measure).<br>它把锁定认同为不返回，不是经典意义的吸引子（吸引一个邻域、极小、有拓扑或度量）。 Witness: `Becoming.Law.Drawn`.
- The mathematics is reused: eventual periodicity on finite sets, and a map that is not injective having a point that is not periodic.<br>数学是复用的：有限集上轨道最终周期，非单射有不周期的点。
- The main law is stated here for determined laws only; for every process, necessarily drawn is not returning and possibly drawn allows return (necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning).<br>主律在此只对确定的律；对每个过程，必然被吸入恰是不返回，可能被吸入允许返回（necessarily-drawn-is-not-returning）。
- Which regions actual unfoldings enter, and how deep or wide a basin is, lie outside the theorems.<br>实际展开进入哪些区域、吸引域多深多宽，不在定理之内。
- Escape from beyond the representation is not stated, a determined law having no move or exchange from beyond.<br>表示之外的逃逸不陈述，确定的律中没有来自其外的动作或交换。
- The finite witnesses, Ratchet and Exit, have two configurations.<br>有限的见证 Ratchet 与 Exit 只有两个配置。
- The links to Capture, Admission and Becoming.Experiment are readings.<br>与 Capture、Admission 与 Becoming.Experiment 的连接是读法。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** An open world separates attraction from merging: counting on draws 0 and merges nothing (Law.succ_drawn_lossless), so Drawn.not_lossless, Lossless.not_drawn, lossless_iff_none_drawn and enters_returning need their list; counting down draws 1 while every number can be had at every step (Law.pred_drawn_keeps), so Drawn.not_keeps, drawn_iff_lost left to right and returns_iff_always_reachable right to left need their list.<br>开放的世界把吸引与合并分开：往上数吸入 0 而不合并（Law.succ_drawn_lossless），所以 Drawn.not_lossless、Lossless.not_drawn、lossless_iff_none_drawn、enters_returning 都需要列表；往下数吸入 1 而每个数在每一步都可得（Law.pred_drawn_keeps），所以 Drawn.not_keeps、drawn_iff_lost 从左到右、returns_iff_always_reachable 从右到左都需要列表。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** A merge draws one of the two, not necessarily both: in Ratchet false and true merge, false is drawn and never returns, and true returns and is not drawn (Ratchet.false_never_returns, Ratchet.true_not_drawn).<br>合并只吸入其一，不必两者：Ratchet 中 false 与 true 被合并，false 被吸入而永不返回，true 返回而不被吸入（Ratchet.false_never_returns、Ratchet.true_not_drawn）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)
- **Counterexample / 反例:** A region every move taken keeps need not be invariant: in Exit, {true} is absorbing under the move false and the run that only moves false stays in it, while the move true leaves it (Exit.locked_in, Exit.not_invariant, Exit.leaving_takes).<br>所取的动作都保持的区域不必是不变量：Exit 中 {true} 在动作 false 下吸收，只取 false 的运行留在其中，而动作 true 离开它（Exit.locked_in、Exit.not_invariant、Exit.leaving_takes）。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Attraction.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren asked “hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?” and pasted an account of a general cause–effect system whose author is not stated (x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t), feedback, adaptive parameters, path dependence, attractors; neither Ren's wording nor a premise). The AI compared and made five proposals, and Ren answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the fourth, “attractors and lock-in are merging”. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): an attractor is an absorbing region a configuration outside it enters, and its basin is what is drawn in; path dependence and lock-in are one law, what is drawn in never comes back; within finitely many configurations attraction and merging go together, while an open world can draw without merging; the future narrows, and read with Ren's “more future, not less” an attractor is the unfolding narrowing its own future; Capture's held rule is an absorbing region in the rule; the meta-attractor of winning, read as an absorbing region only a move not keeping it leaves, is the AI's reading and is not derived.<br>Ren 问“hows cause–effect system comparing to our theory?”，贴来一段作者未注明的一般因果系统说明（x_{t+1} = F(x_t, u_t, ε_t)，反馈、改变自身规则的系统、路径依赖、吸引子；不是 Ren 的话，也不是前提）。AI 作比较并提出五项，Ren 答“Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”。这是第四项“吸引子与锁定就是合并”。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：吸引子是其外的配置进入的吸收区域，吸引域是被吸入者；路径依赖与锁定是同一条规律，被吸入者不再回来；有限多配置之内吸引与合并相伴，开放的世界可以不合并而吸入；未来收窄，合于 Ren 的“more future, not less”，吸引子是展开收窄自己的未来；Capture 中规则所持的结果是规则中的吸收区域；“赢的元吸引子”读作只有不保持它的动作能离开的吸收区域，这一读法属于 AI，没有推出。
